meta.title: A draft opened before the end was pulled in cannot be priced after it
gaps: The plan does not assert the specific HTTP 422 code because the application may return code 32 after the end-of-bidding job discards the draft, code 33 when the order is inactive, or code 508 during extra closing time when counter-offer mod
warnings: a read-back was added in code: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: QA vendor 1 opens a draft bid before the bid end.
The buyer moves the bid end in to 90 seconds from now.
Wait until the new bid end has passed.
QA vendor 1 tries to price the draft after the bid end.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid not found”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
